Method of Attack: Data-wiping malware that violates integrity and availability of information by writing files/disks with zero bytes/arbitrary data and subsequent deletion
Use of Windows group policy (GPO) to launch malware
Remote access to network prior to malware deployment
Deployment of multiple data wipers targeting Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, Solaris systems
Erasing traces of other malware (e.g., Industroyer ICS malware) using data wipers
Discoverer: State Service of Special Communications and Information Protection (SSSCIP) of Ukraine
Impacted Systems: Several data storage systems of Ukrinform (Ukrainian national news agency)
